explication: noTunes is a macOS menu-bar app that blocks iTunes and Apple Music from opening. At launch, it sets up the status-bar control, optionally hides the icon from saved preferences, terminates any already-running target apps, and observes future application launches. The enabled state blocks targets; an optional replacement setting launches another app or URL through macOS `open`. The implementation is concentrated in one sampled source file, so the nodes distinguish its responsibilities rather than implying separate modules.
